Subject: Meridian RV – quick note on positioning
From: Priya Raman <praman@meridian-ca.example>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:40:00 +0000

Hi all,
A few of you asked about our interest-rate exposure after last week's CPI print. Short version: we are running very little outright rate sensitivity. Most of the book is in swap spreads and cash-futures basis, which are largely insulated from parallel moves in yields.
We cut duration earlier in the year and have not added it back. If the March meeting surprises hawkishly we would expect a small positive impact from our curve positions.
Month-to-date we are up roughly 15bps. Happy to set up calls.
Priya
Portfolio Manager, Meridian Rates Relative Value Fund
Fictional fund and people for demonstration purposes.
